div.div: No restart: the providers poll every 30 seconds, so a merged change shows within a minute. The Grafana chart's own RBAC is off: with a sidecar enabled, its ClusterRole would let Grafana read every Secret and ConfigMap in the cluster.

let Grafana read every Secret and ConfigMap in the cluster.
